scenarios.scenario: Switch navigation panes without changing the selected file

scenario_steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
its project navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders
a saved part is selected with its file name and preview displayed
`fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected with its name and preview
the user switches to the system folder navigation pane
common system locations are displayed in the navigation pane
the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed
the user switches back to the project navigation pane
libraries and recent folders are displayed again
the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed

scenarios.scenario: Switch between details and thumbnail file views

scenario_steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved part with a preview is selected in the detailed file list
`fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected in the detailed file list
the user chooses the thumbnail view control
files are displayed as thumbnail tiles
the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed
the user chooses the details view control
files are displayed in rows with Name, Date modified, Type and Size columns
the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed

scenarios.scenario: Reverse the size sort without losing the selected file

scenario_steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the detailed file list contains files of different sizes
OpenSortLarge.opd is selected with its file name and preview displayed
the file list is sorted by decreasing size
`fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenSortSmall.opd`, `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenSortMedium.opd`, and `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenSortLarge.opd` are visible with distinct sizes
the user clicks the Size column header
the file list is sorted by increasing size
the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed
